Episode 246th. Battle for the Mitra Desert (5)
An hour had passed since the first battle between the Vamel Alliance and the enemy tribe ended.
The enemy tribe immediately opened a large dimensional gate and returned to their base, and Jin's group was just getting ready to space-jump to Tikan.
Kadun and the Fire Dragon Corps had returned to the Tower of Story as soon as they started fighting in earnest.
Now only the summoned three demons and Kinzelo's group were left in the desert.
[Hehe, the mighty one who brought us from the abyss finally shows his face!]
Srivee pointed with his finger, and Karmashu and Masalrun turned their heads. Kinzelo's group, who had been hiding while barely surviving the battle, was approaching.
“Wow... it's real! Ranke, this friend really summoned the old demons, right? Berakt, this is totally amazing!”
None of Kinzelo's group thought that Ranke would succeed, but the three demons had not only been summoned but had also changed the course of battle in an instant.

“Lord Ranke, forgive me for ignoring you all this time. The great demon Srivee of Tekan Mountain, the grand duke Karmashu of the blazing fire, and Masalrun of sorrow... I never thought the day would come to see these legendary beings myself. Esteemed demons, I am Shagal of Bahmaga.”
Shagal greeted with the utmost respect, and Bianca followed suit, nodding her head.
“Bianca... Caligo.”
[Judging by your looks, you must be the young ones of Bahmaga and Caligo. Yes, yes. You seem to have done nothing compared to Ranke, but at least you have manners.]
“We... didn’t know... Ranke would, succeed... but we did, cheer...”

[Ah, this one speaks slowly, so it seems you inherited Caligo's most potent blood quite intensely. But you haven't learned properly and haven't fully blossomed yet. Heh, don't worry. I, Srivee, will help you from now on. Of course, if Ranke wants it.]
[If Ranke wants it, we have to do even more.]
[Yes. Ranke Halobiche is, after all, the first demon to summon Masalrun, Srivee, and Karmashu.]
The constant chatter of the three demons was making Ranke's emotions rebound. With his eyes feeling hot, he burst into a hearty laugh.

“Excellent! Srivee, please train Bianca Caligo, my nemesis, as she is still in need of guidance. We Kinzelos are now in a very serious and dangerous time... Also! I sincerely hope that you, the great demon Srivee, will share your secrets with me.”
[Ah, Ranke. Sadly, that's a bit difficult.]
“Why?!”

[Your abilities are nothing compared to Bianca. But it's okay; you'll never be stronger than Bianca, even though it's more difficult than a camel passing through the eye of a needle. But you summoned us, didn't you?]
[Yes, that's even more remarkable. So what if you're not good at fighting? Your name will be recorded forever in the history of the demon world.]
The trio of demons looked at Lanke with strangely pitiful eyes. Lanke was immediately deflated, but the important thing was that Kinzelo had gained a card to use in this crisis.
[But Lanke.]
The sorrowful Masalrun looked into Lanke's eyes.
"Please speak."
[Do you know that your summoning was extremely crude? Ah, don't misunderstand. Masalrun is not belittling you, just talking about the phenomenon.]
"Hmm, I thought there must have been some coincidence that the Sun God observed."

[Yes, it was a coincidence. Your summoning should have actually failed. The ritual was full of flaws, the magic power was lacking, and the control was also at an unacceptable level. Honestly, even now I want to wash my eyes. That garbage-like summoning should not have even been able to summon nameless demon soldiers, let alone Masalrun, Sribee, or Karmashu.]
Masalrun thrust a dagger, not in metaphor, into Lanke's chest with those harsh words. Lanke's face seemed ready to explode with embarrassment, but he couldn't argue with Masalrun.
"So, Lord Masalrun, what are you trying to say...."

[Nevertheless, your summoning was clearly successful. But not a perfect success. That's why Masalrun, Sribee, and Karmashu couldn't bring their full strength. This alone is a fatal error, but there's an even more serious problem.]
At those words, all of Kinzelo's party turned their attention to Masalrun.
"What is the problem?"
[The summoning didn't only affect Masalrun, Sribee, and Karmashu. It also affected some dangerous entities we don't know about...]
Masalrun's eyes narrowed.
[Yes, yes, I felt it too.]
[Me too.]
"Are you talking about Shimat and the enemy tribe?"

[Lanke, it seems you see Masalrun as a fool. They are dangerous, but weren't they the opponents Masalrun just fought? It's not them. In Masalrun's intuition, there are entities that are even more dangerous... and more formidable. They were definite.]
[It's the owners of the blue energy we absorbed at the end of the battle, just before it stopped.]
The Demon Kings.
Ranke's summoning, which happened by chance, was also directly affecting Lafrarosa of the Myeongwang Tribe.
"Myeongwang Tribe......"
"It's the Myeongwang Tribe."
Belakt and Badrei said. Belakt shivered, recalling the humiliation he had suffered when Jin had summoned Linpa with a blackish call during the past sword emperor's war.
"You don't mean to say that the Myeongwang Tribe has been summoned like the demons!?"

[That's not yet certain, Ranke. But in Masalroon's view... it's not a low possibility. That a summoning spell that calls the abyssal beings affected the Myeongwang Tribe means that the dimension in which they currently exist is related to the abyss. So it's not strange that they would be summoned like us.]
The faces of Kinzelo and his party darkened.
What they wanted was for the Vamel Alliance and the Enemy Tribe to fight fiercely and get hurt, not for a massive force to suddenly be added to one side.
Especially the Myeongwang Tribe. If the Vamel Alliance were to obtain the Myeongwang Tribe at this point, they would truly become an overwhelming force.
Particularly among Kinzelo's party were those who had personally witnessed the power of Myeongwang Tribe's warrior Vahn during the time of the evil god's war.
'If such a person joins the Vamel Alliance without the constraints they had during the evil god's war...'
They were like avoiding a fox only to face a tiger. Swallowing hard, Kinzelo's party who remembered Vahn gulped down their dry saliva.
"Then, if we assume that the Myeongwang Tribe is summoned... wouldn't they appear in an incomplete form like the three of you?"
[Are they alive, or are they dead?]
"I'm not sure, but they probably aren't the deceased."

[That's how Masalroon felt as well. Therefore, they are more likely to be summoned in their entirety. Since they won't need to construct a physical or soul body to use in this world, the summoning will undoubtedly be more straightforward.]
[Keke, it's okay, it's okay. Since we are immune to all kinds of attacks anyway, even if such guys are summoned more, we will protect you, Ranke.]
[Of course, it would be better to prevent the Myeongwang Tribe from being summoned at all. Hmm, no immediate solutions come to mind, but we three will somehow try. Hahaha.]
Sribee and Karmashu were making light of the situation as if they didn't realize its gravity. Thus, Ranke, and Kinzelo had no choice but to think.
It seemed that the success of the summoning wasn't entirely something to be happy about.
"An airborne fortress or something, it's definitely annoying. They shoot cannons from long range and then teleport when you try to get close and smash them, Ah! It's not even a damn mosquito."
Tikan.

Murakan exploded in anger as he described the flying fortress, Tikan, that he had attacked, to Jin and his party after their return. While Jin's group was fighting in the desert, Murakan had faced off against the flying fortress 'Rital' that had escaped from the enemy Myeongwang tribe.
"It's far too advanced to be considered a mere mosquito-like weapon. Murakan, if it weren't for you, Tikan would have struggled quite a bit. Many people would have died or been injured."
"That's true, miss Ameris. If we could just restrain its mobility, we could easily smash it, but hm! Kid, what about the results? Was there any success?"

Jin took some time to explain everything that happened in the desert to his companions. From the battle with the Myeongwang tribe to the unexpected intervention of the demons, everyone listened with serious faces.
"...However, the summoning magic of Lanke. It seems to have somehow affected my brothers as well."
"Chief, what do you mean!?"
Qwaul glared at Jin with wide eyes.
"The force I felt when escaping from the enemy's stronghold at the end was clearly the aura of my brothers. Specifically, I believe it resembled that of the Veliz and Linpa brothers."
Each person's energy has its unique characteristics. Upon reflection, that faint aura was strikingly similar to that of Chiltuwang Veliz and Satuwang Linpa.

"There's no way the enemy Myeongwang tribe would have used their space-tracking technology to extract them like madmen, so it must have been the influence of the summoning spell, as the Chief said. Or perhaps the summoned demons played some tricks? Since they have the ability to absorb power, that might be the reason. Oh, whatever it is, it's an incredible success!"
Qwaul raised his voice, quite excited.
"Is it something to get so excited about, Qwaul?"

"Of course! Even the wave-tracking synchronization device I created for the Chief's divine unification couldn't pull the power of the Myeongwang tribe into this world without Jin as a medium. But now Jin is saying that the aura of the Myeongwang tribe manifested in the desert without any device or himself serving as a medium."
That meant that a small passage had already been created between Lafrarosa and the Mithra Desert!
As Qwaul continued, Eltiot was the first to nod.

"I was too tired to feel that aura at the time, but if the energy of someone living in Lafrarosa really appeared in the desert, then Qwaul must be right. We didn't make any special attempts to contact Lafrarosa while fighting. Perhaps the distinction between dimensions has blurred due to the effects of the summoning spell and the battle."
"Then what we have to do from now on is to widen that passage."
As Jin spoke, Qwaul jumped up from his seat.
"Chief, let's go back to the desert right now! I need to go and see the scene myself. I have a feeling. I feel like I'll be able to find a clue soon!"
